Feature: Access Control and User-Doctor-Patient Mapping
  As a system user
    Given I have a login with a valid User-id and password
    And I am trying to access the system
    When I enter my credentials into the login form
    Then I should be granted access if my User-id and password are valid and the system is available on the specified PinCodes
    
Scenario: Access granted with valid credentials on available PinCodes
  Args:
    pincode: "ValidPinCode"
  When: I enter my credentials into the login form
  Then:
    | System State          | Expected Outcome                                  |
    | Access Granted       | I should be granted access                        |

Scenario: Access denied with invalid credentials on available PinCodes
  Args:
    pincode: "ValidPinCode"
  When: I enter incorrect credentials into the login form
  Then:
    | System State          | Expected Outcome                                  |
    | Access Denied        | I should see an "Invalid Credentials" error message |

Feature: User Management
  As a system administrator
    Given the system is operational and secure
    And I have a list of Users with their login credentials
    When I attempt to add a new User
    Then the User should be added to the system if the credentials are unique and valid

Scenario: Adding a new User with valid credentials
  Args:
    user_id: "NewUser123"
    password: "SecurePass123"
  When: I add a new User with the provided credentials
  Then:
    | System State          | Expected Outcome                                  |
    | User Added          | The new User should be present in the system       |

Scenario: Adding a new User with duplicate credentials
  Args:
    user_id: "NewUser123"
    password: "SecurePass123"
  When: I attempt to add a new User with provided credentials (duplicate)
  Then:
    | System State          | Expected Outcome                                  |
    | Duplicate Error      | The system should not add the duplicate User     |

Feature: Speciality and Doctor Mapping
  As a system administrator
    Given multiple Specialities exist
    And each Speciality has linked Doctors
    When I assign a Doctor to a Speciality
    Then the Doctor should be linked to only one Speciality

Scenario: Assigning a Doctor to a Speciality
  Args:
    doctor_id: "Doc456"
    speciality: "Cardiology"
  When: I assign the Doctor to the specified Speciality
  Then:
    | System State          | Expected Outcome                                  |
    | Doctor Assigned      | The Doctor should be linked to "Cardiology"       |

Scenario: Assigning a Doctor to multiple Specialities
  Args:
    doctor_id: "Doc45thy"
    specialities: ["Cardiology", "Neurology"]
  When: I incorrectly attempt to assign the Doctor to multiple Specialities
  Then:
    | System State          | Expected Outcome                                  |
    | Error               | The Doctor should only be linked to one Speciality |

Feature: Patient Registration and Consultation Request
  As a system user
    Given I wish to register as a Patient
    And I provide my details to create a Patient profile
    When I submit my Patient profile
    Then I should receive a unique Patient id

Scenario: Patient registration with valid details
  Args:
    patient_details: { "name": "John Doe", "dob": "1990-01-01", "contact": "555-1234" }
  When: I submit my Patient profile with valid details
  Then:
    | System State          | Expected Outcome                                  |
    | Patient Registered   | I should receive a unique Patient id             |

Scenario: Patient registration with invalid details
  Args:
    patient_details: { "name": "", "dob": "invalid-date", "contact": "123-456-7890" }
  When: I submit my Patient profile with invalid details
  Then:
    | System State          | Expected Outcome                                  |
    | Error               | The system should not register the Patient     |

Feature: Patient Consultation Request
  As a system user
    Given I am registered as a Patient
    And I wish to request a consultation
    When I request a consultation for a Doctor
    Then I should be able to request for one or more consultations

Scenario: Requesting a single consultation
  Args:
    doctor_id: "Doc456"
    patient_id: "RegisteredPatient123"
  When: I request a single consultation for the Doctor
  Then:
    | System State          | Expected Outcome                                  |
    | Request Confirmed   | I should receive confirmation for the request    |

Scenario: Requesting multiple consultations
  Args:
    doctor_id: "Doc456"
    patient_id: "RegisteredPatient123"
  When: I request multiple consultations for the Doctor
  Then:
    | System State          | Expected Outcome                                  |
    | Request Confirmed   | I should receive confirmation for each request    |

Scenario: Requesting a consultation with invalid Doctor
  Args:
    doctor_id: "InvalidDoctor123"
  When: I request a consultation for an invalid Doctor
  Then:
    | System State          | Expected Outcome                                  |
    | Error               | The system should not proceed with the request  |
